modules.name: kimi_cli.cli
modules.description: CLI entry point using Typer. Parses command-line arguments and routes to appropriate UI modes (shell/print/acp/wire).
modules.interfaces: Entry point for `kimi` command. Creates KimiCLI instance and runs it in shell, print, ACP, or wire mode. Sub-commands: `info`, `mcp`, `term`, `acp`.

modules.name: kimi_cli.app
modules.description: Main application class (KimiCLI) that orchestrates configuration loading, model selection, agent loading, and runtime setup.
modules.interfaces: KimiCLI.create() factory method, run() for direct Wire output, run_shell() for interactive TUI, run_print() for non-interactive output, run_acp() for ACP server, run_wire_stdio() for Wire over stdio.

modules.name: kimi_cli.soul
modules.description: Core agent runtime and soul loop. Contains KimiSoul which is the main agent loop executing LLM steps, tool calls, and context management.
modules.interfaces: Soul protocol defines run(), status, available_slash_commands. KimiSoul implements the main agent loop. run_soul() connects soul to UI via Wire. wire_send() for outputting messages.

modules.name: kimi_cli.soul.agent
modules.description: Agent and runtime definitions. Runtime holds configuration, LLM, session, approvals, skills, and labor market. Agent wraps system prompt and toolset.
modules.interfaces: Runtime.create() builds runtime with skills discovery. load_agent() loads agent from YAML spec. LaborMarket manages fixed and dynamic subagents. Agent holds name, system_prompt, toolset, runtime.

modules.name: kimi_cli.soul.context
modules.description: Conversation history management with checkpointing for D-Mail time travel feature. Stores messages in JSONL file backend.
modules.interfaces: Context.restore() loads history from file. append_message() adds messages. checkpoint() creates restore point. revert_to() for time travel. clear() resets history.

modules.name: kimi_cli.soul.toolset
modules.description: Tool loading, execution, and MCP integration. KimiToolset loads tools by import path, injects dependencies, and manages MCP server connections.
modules.interfaces: KimiToolset.load_tools() loads callable tools. load_mcp_tools() connects to MCP servers. handle() executes tool calls. MCPTool wraps MCP protocol tools.

modules.name: kimi_cli.soul.approval
modules.description: User approval system for tool actions. Manages approval queue, auto-approve actions, and YOLO mode.
modules.interfaces: Approval.request() asks user for permission. fetch_request() gets pending approval. resolve_request() handles response. is_yolo() checks auto-approve mode.

modules.name: kimi_cli.soul.compaction
modules.description: Context compaction when conversation exceeds token limits. Summarizes history to fit within model context window.
modules.interfaces: SimpleCompaction.compact() summarizes messages using LLM.

modules.name: kimi_cli.wire
modules.description: Communication layer between soul and UI using single-producer multiple-consumer (SPMC) pattern. Uses BroadcastQueue for message distribution to multiple UI subscribers.
modules.interfaces: Wire class with soul_side and ui_side(merge) factory. WireSoulSide.send() for output. WireUISide.receive() for consuming messages. Multiple UI sides can subscribe to the same Wire. Records to wire.jsonl file.

submodules.name: types
submodules.description: Wire message type definitions including events and requests
submodules.interfaces: Event and Request union types. WireMessageEnvelope for serialization. is_event(), is_request(), is_wire_message() type guards.

internal.relationships: Wire uses BroadcastQueue for SPMC distribution; WireSoulSide sends to queues; WireUISide subscribes and receives

modules.name: kimi_cli.wire.types
modules.description: Wire message type definitions including events (TurnBegin, StepBegin, ContentPart, ToolResult) and requests (ApprovalRequest).
modules.interfaces: Event and Request union types. WireMessageEnvelope for serialization. is_event(), is_request(), is_wire_message() type guards.

modules.name: kimi_cli.config
modules.description: Configuration management. Loads/saves TOML config with LLM providers, models, loop control, and service settings.
modules.interfaces: Config model with providers, models, loop_control, services, mcp. load_config() from file. save_config() to file. Supports JSON-to-TOML migration.

modules.name: kimi_cli.tools
modules.description: Built-in tools: shell (bash/powershell), file operations (read/write/replace/glob/grep), web (fetch/search), todo, multiagent (Task), dmail, think.
modules.interfaces: CallableTool and CallableTool2 interfaces. Tools loaded via import path strings like 'kimi_cli.tools.shell:Shell'. Each tool has markdown description.

modules.name: kimi_cli.tools.multiagent
modules.description: Subagent task delegation. Task tool spawns subagents with isolated context for parallel work.
modules.interfaces: Task tool params: description, subagent_name, prompt. Runs subagent in fresh context, returns final response. Wraps subagent events in SubagentEvent.

modules.name: kimi_cli.ui.shell
modules.description: Interactive shell UI with prompt_toolkit. Handles user input, slash commands, keyboard shortcuts, and rich output rendering.
modules.interfaces: Shell class with run() method. Slash command registries for shell-level and soul-level commands. Supports image paste, shell mode toggle, session management.

modules.name: kimi_cli.ui.print
modules.description: Non-interactive print UI for scripting. Supports text and stream-json input/output formats.
modules.interfaces: Print class with run() method. Input from stdin or --prompt. Output to stdout. final_only mode for just final message.

modules.name: kimi_cli.ui.wire
modules.description: Wire server over stdio for external integrations. Uses JSON-RPC-like protocol.
modules.interfaces: WireOverStdio class with serve() method. Reads requests from stdin, writes responses to stdout.

modules.name: kimi_cli.acp
modules.description: ACP (Agent Communication Protocol) server for IDE integrations like Cursor. Exposes agent capabilities over stdio.
modules.interfaces: ACPServer with initialize(), new_session(), prompt(), cancel() etc. Translates ACP protocol to KimiCLI operations.

modules.name: kimi_cli.flow
modules.description: Prompt flow execution from D2 or Mermaid flowcharts. Supports task and decision nodes.
modules.interfaces: PromptFlow with nodes and edges. parse_d2_flowchart() and parse_mermaid_flowchart() parsers. FlowRunner executes flows.

modules.name: kimi_cli.agentspec
modules.description: Agent specification YAML loader. Supports extension, tool lists, subagent definitions, and system prompt templates.
modules.interfaces: load_agent_spec() from YAML file. AgentSpec model with name, tools, exclude_tools, subagents, system_prompt_path.

modules.name: kimi_cli.skill
modules.description: Skills system for reusable agent capabilities. Discovers skills from directories, registers as slash commands.
modules.interfaces: discover_skills_from_roots() finds SKILL.md files. index_skills() builds name->skill mapping. read_skill_text() loads skill content.

modules.name: kimi_cli.session
modules.description: Session management for conversation persistence. Creates session directories with context files.
modules.interfaces: Session.create(), Session.find(), Session.continue_(), Session.list(). Sessions stored in ~/.kimi/sessions/.

modules.name: kimi_cli.llm
modules.description: LLM provider abstraction. Creates chat providers for Kimi, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.
modules.interfaces: create_llm() factory. LLM class wraps chat_provider. augment_provider_with_env_vars() for KIMI_API_KEY etc.

modules.name: kimi_cli.utils
modules.description: Utility modules including async primitives, string processing, datetime formatting, and rich text helpers.
modules.interfaces: Various utility functions used across the codebase.

submodules.name: broadcast
submodules.description: BroadcastQueue for SPMC (single-producer multiple-consumer) async message distribution
submodules.interfaces: BroadcastQueue.subscribe() returns Queue, publish() sends to all subscribers, shutdown() closes all queues

submodules.name: aioqueue
submodules.description: Async Queue with shutdown support, compatible with Python < 3.13
submodules.interfaces: Queue with get/put/shutdown methods. QueueShutDown exception raised on closed queue operations.

internal.relationships: BroadcastQueue uses aioqueue.Queue internally for each subscriber

modules.name: packages/kosong
modules.description: LLM framework library. Provides chat providers, message types, tool interfaces, and step execution.
modules.interfaces: kosong.step() for LLM inference. ChatProvider protocol. Message, ContentPart, ToolCall types. Toolset for tool management.

modules.name: packages/kaos
modules.description: Async filesystem abstraction. Provides KaosPath for unified local/SSH path operations.
modules.interfaces: KaosPath with async read/write/exists operations. Supports local filesystem and SSH remotes.

modules.name: tests_ai
modules.description: AI-driven test/audit framework using Kimi CLI agents to verify codebase invariants. Contains markdown test specs and agent-based orchestration.
modules.interfaces: run.py CLI script executes audits and emits pytest-style results. Test specs (test_*.md) define requirements with Scope and Requirements sections. Agent outputs report.json with pass/fail per case.

submodules.name: scripts/main.yaml
submodules.description: Main agent spec that orchestrates test execution by spawning worker subagents in parallel for each test file
submodules.interfaces: Extends default agent, spawns worker subagents via Task tool, outputs report.json

submodules.name: scripts/worker.yaml
submodules.description: Worker subagent spec that examines a single test file and reports pass/fail for each case
submodules.interfaces: Extends default agent, uses D-Mail for context rewinding between cases, returns summary to main agent

submodules.name: scripts/run.py
submodules.description: Python runner script that invokes the main agent and parses report.json to emit pytest-style output
submodules.interfaces: CLI: run.py [tests_dir], reads report.json, prints PASSED/FAILED per case with colored summary

internal.relationships: run.py → main.yaml agent → worker.yaml subagents → report.json → run.py output

modules.name: .kimi/prompts
modules.description: Project-local prompt templates for developer workflows. These markdown files are used with Kimi CLI to automate release, PR creation, changelog generation, and documentation tasks.
modules.interfaces: Markdown prompt files loaded by developers to guide Kimi CLI through common workflows. Each prompt contains instructions in Chinese describing a multi-step workflow.

submodules.name: release.md
submodules.description: Release automation workflow: checks for package changes since last tag, updates version in pyproject.toml, CHANGELOG.md, and docs, creates bump branch, opens PR, and guides through tagging
submodules.interfaces: Input: none. Output: bump-<package>-<version> branch with version updates, PR created via gh CLI

submodules.name: pr.md
submodules.description: PR creation workflow: checks for dirty changes, ensures on feature branch, pushes and creates PR with English title/description following commit message conventions
submodules.interfaces: Input: clean git state on feature branch. Output: PR created via gh CLI with conventional commit title

submodules.name: gen-changelog.md
submodules.description: Changelog generation: adds entries to CHANGELOG.md based on diff between current branch and main, following existing format
submodules.interfaces: Input: branch with changes. Output: updated CHANGELOG.md entries

submodules.name: gen-docs.md
submodules.description: Documentation update workflow: syncs English changelog via script, updates Chinese docs based on code changes, then runs translate-docs.md for bilingual sync
submodules.interfaces: Input: code changes. Output: updated docs/ with synced EN/CN content

submodules.name: translate-docs.md
submodules.description: Documentation translation: translates page-by-page ensuring CN/EN sync. Changelog: EN→CN. Other pages: CN→EN. Maintains consistent style while respecting language-specific conventions
submodules.interfaces: Input: CN docs as source (except changelog). Output: synchronized EN/CN documentation

internal.relationships: release.md may call gen-docs.md → translate-docs.md for full release workflow

modules.name: flake.nix
modules.description: Nix flake for building and packaging kimi-cli. Uses uv2nix to convert Python dependencies from uv.lock to Nix derivations. Provides reproducible builds across platforms.
modules.interfaces: nix build .#kimi-cli builds the package. nix run .#kimi-cli runs kimi. Also provides kimi-cli-memo variant with memo MCP pre-configured. Wrapper includes ripgrep in PATH and sets KIMI_CLI_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1.

modules.name: sdks/kimi-sdk
modules.description: Lightweight Python SDK for the Kimi API. Provides async generate() and step() functions for chat completions and tool calling. Re-exports types from kosong library (Kimi provider, Message, tooling types). Version 0.1.1, requires Python 3.12+.
modules.interfaces: generate(chat_provider, system_prompt, tools, history) for chat completions. step(chat_provider, system_prompt, toolset, history) for tool calling with StepResult. Kimi class as chat provider. Message, ContentPart, Tool* types for building agent workflows. Env vars: KIMI_API_KEY, KIMI_BASE_URL.

## Module Dependencies

```mermaid
graph TD
  cli[kimi_cli.cli] --> app[kimi_cli.app]
  app --> soul[kimi_cli.soul]
  app --> config[kimi_cli.config]
  app --> session[kimi_cli.session]
  app --> llm[kimi_cli.llm]
  soul --> agent[kimi_cli.soul.agent]
  soul --> context[kimi_cli.soul.context]
  soul --> toolset[kimi_cli.soul.toolset]
  soul --> approval[kimi_cli.soul.approval]
  soul --> wire[kimi_cli.wire]
  wire --> broadcast[kimi_cli.utils.broadcast]
  wire --> aioqueue[kimi_cli.utils.aioqueue]
  agent --> agentspec[kimi_cli.agentspec]
  agent --> skill[kimi_cli.skill]
  toolset --> tools[kimi_cli.tools]
  toolset --> mcp[MCP via fastmcp]
  app --> ui_shell[kimi_cli.ui.shell]
  app --> ui_print[kimi_cli.ui.print]
  app --> ui_acp[kimi_cli.acp]
  app --> ui_wire[kimi_cli.ui.wire]
  llm --> kosong[packages/kosong]
  tools --> kaos[packages/kaos]
```

## Key Relationships

- **CLI -> App**: Entry point creates KimiCLI and runs in appropriate UI mode
- **App -> Soul**: KimiCLI creates KimiSoul which runs the main agent loop
- **Soul -> Wire**: Soul sends events/requests to UI via Wire message passing
- **Wire -> BroadcastQueue**: Wire uses BroadcastQueue for SPMC distribution to multiple UI subscribers
- **Soul -> Toolset**: KimiSoul executes tool calls through KimiToolset
- **Toolset -> Tools**: Built-in tools and MCP tools loaded by KimiToolset
- **Agent -> LaborMarket**: Fixed subagents loaded from agent spec, dynamic subagents created via Task tool
- **Context -> Session**: Context file persisted in session directory
- **LLM -> kosong**: Chat providers from kosong library
